id./param/scenario/cs/b_030_cs_010.pack|cs_: "So this is a place tied to the Luminary...
"Yet it is so close to where the Tree fell, and the temple looks untouched. What happened here...
"That face... I know it! You're a Heliodor soldier!
"Heliodorian! You blockaded our temple! Feel the wrath of the disciples of Angri-La!
"Hm, what are these movements... I can't tell where they'll strike! {var:1}, stay alert!
"I heard a commotion. What is this? I will not tolerate rudeness to visitors.
"High Lama! N-No, it's not what you think! A suspicious Heliodor soldier came, so we were questioning him!
"I see. Indeed. But the young one there does not look like a soldier.
"...The power I sense from you. Could you be... the Luminary?
"...What are you saying? This holy power is not something you can hide.
"He saw {var:1}'s true identity at a glance...
"Ah... how long I have awaited this moment.
"I am very sorry for these disciples' rude behavior.
"Later, please visit the High Hall at the highest point of the temple. I have something to tell you.
"A strange child. So young, yet he sees through us with a curious dignity.
"We have no other lead. Let's go to the High Hall as he said."
